input: Approved change notes: CN1 says workspace owners can export a member list as CSV. Affected audiences: workspace owners on the Team plan. Release status: limited beta. Limitations: exports contain names and email addresses only; beta access is enabled for selected workspaces. Required action: none. Evidence references: DOC1 supports CN1 and the listed limitations. Permitted CTA: “Read the beta guide.”

headline_options: Limited beta: member-list CSV export for selected Team workspaces
Team workspace owners can try member-list CSV export in limited beta
expected_artifact.confirmed_change: Workspace owners in selected Team-plan workspaces can export a member list as CSV.
expected_artifact.audience_impact: The documented change applies to workspace owners on the Team plan whose workspaces have beta access.
expected_artifact.limitation: Exports contain only names and email addresses, and access is limited to selected workspaces.

fact_trace.statement: Workspace owners can export a member list as CSV.
Access is limited to selected Team workspaces.
